name: robin-cad-sim-studio
description: Portable CAD-to-simulation studio facade with shared task, routing, evidence, and cross-agent contracts.

interface.shortDescription: One entry point from CAD and mesh through simulation, verification, and reporting.
interface.longDescription: A portable facade plugin for Codex, Claude, Hermes, and Pi-style hosts. It owns scientific problem framing, workflow selection, verification gates, output organization, and shared JSON contracts while delegating deterministic execution to existing CLI backends and optional live MCP bridges.
defaultPrompt: Run the smallest credible CAD to mesh to simulation workflow for this biomedical device.
Route this microfluidic chip request through OpenFOAM, FEniCS special physics, and verification as needed.
Verify these existing XDMF or VTK simulation results and prepare a report-ready evidence bundle.
Use the same CAD-to-simulation route in Codex, Claude, or Hermes.
